basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming Marina style home in the heart of the Excelsior neighborhood. Upon entry, one feels the graciousness of this home, with gorgeous refinished hardwood floors w/inlay details, beautiful original wood doors and moldings, a wood-burning fireplace, vaulted living room, formal dining room, spacious kitchen with brand new appliances and sunny adjacent breakfast room. The rear of the home features two spacious light-filled bedrooms and a split bath in the hallway. Expansive western views of Mt. Davidson & Sutro Tower.  Downstairs there is a huge bonus room, full bath, laundry, and 2-car garage with room for further expansion. The deep and sunny backyard is a perfect oasis. Updates include freshly painted inside and out, upgraded electrical wiring, new yard fence & more. Truly a gem!
